details.description:
You see Aldern, sweaty, filthy, and wild-eyed, digging away at the stone f loor of this room with a pickaxe. With each swing, he grunts out two words: “For you.” You knows that Aldern is speaking of you. As the vision ends, Aldern breaks through into the room beyond, and a horde of shrieking ghouls rises up to pull him into the darkness below. A moment later, the ghouls turn their lambent eyes upon you and their clawed hands, dripping with blood and tattered flesh reach for you...

Obsessed Haunt: This haunt affects the target of Aldern Foxglove's obsession, which attracts Vorel Foxglmre's own obsession with eternal life. If no creature in a group of creatures is haunted by obsession, then this haunt may target anyone.
details.reset: The haunt automatically resets after 1 day until the supernatural fungus in B37 is dealt with, even if the haunt was previously disabled.
details.routine:
Trigger Haunted creature enters the room. Triggering creature nrust make a @Check[type:will|dc:25|basic:true] save or be trapped and unable to move from the room as described in the Haunt’s routine.

Routine: Ghoulish Hands Trigger Haunted creature sets foot on the stars. Creature must make a @Check[type:will|dc:25|basic:true] save  against[[/r (4d8+10)[piercing]]] damage. If the creature fails or criticdly fails they are exposed to Ghast Fever

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 [[/r 3d8[void]]] damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 [[/r 3d8[void]]] damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.VC7rtYR4hLxwg7WZ]{Ghast} the next midnight.
